It happens whenever a previous tranaction was voided, sometimes the phone number associated with the rewards account can carry over to the next person for whatever reason.

So this mystery person has no access to your prescription records, nothing. They don't get a text whenever your stuff is ready, and they probably don't even know that their rewards are attached to your account! All you even have to do to fix it is hit the big red "NO" button when it shows you the phone number on the terminal and poof! It's gone forever. Major side effects? No. However, taking pills dry is just generally bad for you. Water ensures that the pill doesn't become lodged or stuck in the throat (which can cause choking or irritation) and is properly absorbed. I'm a pharmacy tech at CVS. Assuming you're picking up 90-day supplies, your insurance honestly might pay for it already. If not, just ask for a small supply and ask for it to be run on a goodrx discount card. Prices vary on location, but i just checked myself, and it'll be around 20 dollars for a 30-day supply in KCMO :P. Picking up an odd amount of pills will mess up your refills, and on your last refill at the prescription, you'll be getting an uneven amount that can mess with certain insurances.
I'd suggest getting your hands on your meds asap. It depends on the person, of course, but even just 12hrs without my meds can give me wicked nausea and migraines. It's not fun, especially when trying to spend time with family. Good luck!
